study_design: Post-hoc fixed-budget benchmark after GNN results were known; not a prospective blind comparison or causal graph ablation

features.normalization: node and edge population mean/std fitted on training layouts only; then 48 pooled feature mean/std fitted on training layouts only; all scale floors 1e-6
features.pooling: concatenate node mean,max,sign(sum)*log1p(abs(sum)), then the same edge statistics

target_transform: train-standardized log1p, population std floor 1e-8; expm1 inverse without clipping

evaluation.primary: per-target paired family-macro MAPE difference, baseline minus archived GNN on identical split/init cells
evaluation.aggregation: mean, minimum, maximum across the fixed 25-cell grid plus paired crossed-axis resampling

resampling.semantics: descriptive seed-grid sensitivity interval, not a population confidence interval

evaluation.deterministic_model_initializations: constant and ridge are duplicated controls; not independent initialization replicates
evaluation.r4: excluded from this baseline study; no new R4 claim

retry_policy: one fixed full array; failed attempts retained, any training retry requires a new protocol identity

checkpoint.format: numeric NPZ allow_pickle=False; packed tree arrays

sandbox.training_files: selected split-scoped training dataset only; no test/R4/other-split bytes or checkpoint outputs
